BJP holds march commemorating 1984 anti-Sikh violence

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) held a march to commemorate the 1984 anti-Sikh violence. This event was framed by the BJP as a rebuttal to the INDIA bloc's Ramlila rally and was also linked to recent state election defeats.
